content.text:
Here's what I found on Bangkok Prep's admissions and fees.

## Admission process

Bangkok Prep is a British curriculum school.
Its Primary campus (Early Years to Year 6) is next door to its Secondary campus (Year 7 to Year 13) on Sukhumvit 77.
You start by filling in a short enquiry form. The school then invites you for an introductory visit and tour.
If you decide on Bangkok Prep, you submit the application form and the required documents.

3. **Assessment.** The length depends on your child's year level:
   -

Younger children attend a welcome session in a classroom. Older children take the CAT4 test.
4. **Decision.**
The school considers the assessment results, school reports and how many places are available.
If your child is accepted, you get a formal offer letter and an invoice for the initial fees (placement, security deposit and registration). These must be paid by the deadline to secure the place.
A Government Liaison Officer helps international families apply for students' Non-Ed visas and parents' visas.

## Tuition fees

**2025–2026 annual tuition** (from a third-party listing):
| Year group | Fee (THB) |
|---|---|
| Daycare | 295,000 – 370,000 |
| Nursery | 575,930 |
| Reception | 609,003 |
| Years 1–2 | 682,500 |
| Years 3–4 | 703,500 |
| Years 5–6 | 719,250 |
| Year 7 | 756,000 |
| Year 11 | 808,500 |
| Year 12 | 821,100 |
| Year 13 | 714,000 |
**2026–2027:** A review site citing the school's website gives
annual tuition from THB 384,800 (Pre-Nursery, full day) to THB 862,200 (Year 12).
Registration fee: THB 110,000–160,000 depending on stage (non-refundable)
Meals (except Years 12–13), world languages, trips and a 1:1 device for Years 3–11. Exam fees are extra.
The school can require some students to take English as an Additional Language (EAL) or Learning Support (LS) programmes, which cost extra. If a student needs both, only the LS fee is charged.
The fee figures above come from third-party sites and don't fully agree with each other, so treat them as estimates. For confirmed numbers, download the official fee schedule from the school's
at bangkokprep.ac.th, or contact the admissions team.
